items.title: Criterion: locally of finite type and injective on every etale base change forces universal injectivity
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces), section on universally injective morphisms
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The criterion takes a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a scheme S that is locally of finite type and such that |X x_Y V| -> |V| is injective for every etale V -> Y, and concludes that f is universally injective (statement lines 212-222). The proof is a chain of four reductions: etale-localness on the base, local quasi-finiteness from a Decent Spaces criterion, realisation of finite separable residue field extensions by etale covers of Y, and geometric connectedness of the fibre (proof lines 225-245). The step that needs real content is the fourth: the one-point fibre must be tested after every finite separable extension, which is exactly what the etale realisation lemma buys, and only then does pure inseparability of kappa(x)/kappa(y) follow (proof lines 236-247). The author leaves the final passage from the fibre description to radiciality as a routine check, so H2.
